method: SAM 3D Body (sam_3d_body_dinov3_bf16, ComfyUI core nodes) on each frame, whole frame as the box, hand refinement on; SAM3DBody_Smooth savgol window 7; BVH via BuildPoseFile, camera translation off. Made with: python h3band/sam3d_mocap.py work/ref/clips/chad_otherside.mp4 work/sam3d/chad. Shot times from ffmpeg scene detection (threshold 0.3, and 0.08 for the 22.56 s cut).

sources.content: Chad Smith drum cam performance of 'Otherside' (multi-camera), work/ref/clips/chad_otherside.mp4; source URL not recorded

skipped.why: talking to camera, then not playing

head_pitch.desc: head forward axis below the trunk's forward, + = looking down

head_yaw.desc: head turned from the trunk's forward, + = toward the drummer's right

head_roll.desc: head up axis tipped from the trunk's up, + = toward the right shoulder

trunk_flex.desc: pelvis -> neck tipped forward of the pelvis frame's up (hips hidden in footage)

trunk_side.desc: pelvis -> neck tipped toward the right (hips hidden in footage)

trunk_twist.desc: shoulder line turned from the hip line, + = chest toward the right (hips hidden)

elbow_flex_R.desc: R elbow flexion: upper arm to forearm, 0 = straight

ua_elev_R.desc: R upper arm from hanging (trunk down), 90 = level

ua_abd_R.desc: R upper arm out to the side of the trunk, + = elbow away from the body

ua_fwd_R.desc: R upper arm forward of the trunk, + = elbow in front

elbow_flex_L.desc: L elbow flexion: upper arm to forearm, 0 = straight

ua_elev_L.desc: L upper arm from hanging (trunk down), 90 = level

ua_abd_L.desc: L upper arm out to the side of the trunk, + = elbow away from the body

ua_fwd_L.desc: L upper arm forward of the trunk, + = elbow in front

wrist_fwd_R.desc: R wrist forward of the shoulder in the trunk frame, in arm lengths (kit layout)

wrist_up_R.desc: R wrist up of the shoulder in the trunk frame, in arm lengths (kit layout)

wrist_out_R.desc: R wrist out to the side of the shoulder in the trunk frame, in arm lengths (kit layout)

wrist_fwd_L.desc: L wrist forward of the shoulder in the trunk frame, in arm lengths (kit layout)

wrist_up_L.desc: L wrist up of the shoulder in the trunk frame, in arm lengths (kit layout)

wrist_out_L.desc: L wrist out to the side of the shoulder in the trunk frame, in arm lengths (kit layout)

nod.desc: head_pitch p5-p95 range in a 2 s window

head_turn.desc: head_yaw p5-p95 range in a 2 s window

head_tilt.desc: head_roll p5-p95 range in a 2 s window

trunk_sway.desc: p95 angle of the trunk's up axis from its 2 s mean, in the world

shoulder_turn.desc: p5-p95 range of the shoulder line's heading about the trunk axis, in the world

elbow_lift_R.desc: R ua_elev p5-p95 range in a 2 s window

elbow_bend_R.desc: R elbow_flex p5-p95 range in a 2 s window

elbow_lift_L.desc: L ua_elev p5-p95 range in a 2 s window

elbow_bend_L.desc: L elbow_flex p5-p95 range in a 2 s window
